description: Share something the user made on a device with every SynthHub user, under CC BY-SA 4.0: a sound, a sequence or pattern, a kit, a project, a bank of their own sounds, or a MIDI clip any device can play. Its content: the device's own data (SysEx, e.g. from backup_presets), settings by driver address (from list_routes, e.g. {'/filter/cutoff': [90]}, which also works for devices without dumps), and/or a standard MIDI file. Only what the user made: never factory presets, nor sounds or sequences bought or downloaded from others — set own_sound only after asking the user. Made from someone else's shared preset? Pass derived_from: it credits them, as the licence requires. Describe it well (category, genres, tags, tempo, key, tips): that is how people find it. The same content shared twice returns the existing id; the author publishes new versions with update_preset and can withdraw it (withdraw_preset). Through a relay, the device data can be captured from the device itself: pass code and start the dump from the device's menu during the call, or give request_hex (the device's dump-request message, which the user accepts at the relay). An audio preview is added by its author with PUT /u/<account>/v1/presets/<id>/audio (MP3, Ogg, M4A or WebM, 1 MB at most).

category.description: The kind of sound or part.

code.description: A relay's pairing code: capture the device data from the device instead of hex.

derived_from.description: Id of the shared preset it was made from.

description.description: What it sounds like (500 characters at most).

firmware.description: Firmware version of the device it was made on.

hex.description: The device data as SysEx, in hex (64 KB at most).

librarian.description: The synth the librarian took it from (take_sound's librarian): loading it then goes through the same exchange, fitted to the receiving synth.

midi_base64.description: A standard MIDI file, base64 (64 KB at most).

own_sound.description: Must be true: the user made it (not a factory preset, not someone else's).

port.description: With code: the device's port name (or part of it), when the relay has several.

request_hex.description: With code: the device's dump-request SysEx, sent first (e.g. 'F0 42 30 00 01 2C 10 F7').

seconds.description: With code: how long to wait for the dump (default 5).

settings.description: Settings by driver address: {'/filter/cutoff': [90], '/amp/attack': [12]} (512 at most).

tags.description: Character and free words: 'warm', 'dark', 'evolving'… (8 at most).

tips.description: How to play it: mod wheel, aftertouch, register… (500 characters at most).

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: share_preset
